panels.title: Ready
panels.description: Up means Prometheus reaches zkboost. Validator means zkboost is ready to prove and sign.

panels.title: Payload Age
panels.description: Time since the slot start of the newest valid payload. It grows when the CL stops sending payloads.

panels.title: Queue Depth
panels.description: Proofs waiting for a prover, per proof type.

panels.title: Payload Arrival Delay
panels.description: Time from the slot start until zkboost receives the payload. Bars count the payloads later than 12 s.

panels.title: EL Payload Status
panels.description: EL answers to new payloads. Only VALID payloads are proven.

panels.title: Request Duration
panels.description: Mean round trip of the calls that returned a witness.

panels.title: Prove Duration
panels.description: Prove duration percentiles of successful proofs. Failed and timed-out attempts are not included. The red line is one slot (12 s).

panels.title: Prove Duration Distribution
panels.description: Successful proofs per prove duration bucket in the selected time range.
Proof results per proof type in the selected time range. On time means accepted within 12 s of the slot start.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (proof_type) (increase(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="12.0"}[$__range])) / (sum by (proof_type) (increase(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (proof_type) (increase(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_count{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type"}[$__range])) - sum by (proof_type) (increase(zkboost_proof_slot_latency_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", proof_type=~"$proof_type", le="12.0"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Proof Outcomes
Proof Latency
panels.description: p99 time until a proof is accepted, from the slot start and from the payload receipt. CL arrival is the payload delay before zkboost. Red is later than one slot (12 s).

panels.title: Proof Lateness ($proof_type)
panels.description: Accepted proofs per minute, grouped by the time from the slot start to acceptance.

panels.title: Submission Duration
panels.description: Time to submit an accepted proof, with retries. Failed submissions are not included.
